name: Extract From File
label: Parse CSV / spreadsheet / PDF text / ICS
description: Extracts structured data from a platform file ref. PDF is text-only. Size cap. Input `file` is type file.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Extract From File operation. Set operation (or rely on config). Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'from_csv'.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Source file ref. Required. Type file.

schema.label: header_row
schema.description: Override config header_row (JSON boolean only when sent on the wire).

schema.label: sheet
schema.description: Sheet name or 0-based index for from_xlsx / from_xls / from_ods. Example: 'Sheet1'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Secrets redacted. File-producing ops also set `file` (type file). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Result file ref when the operation produces a file. Type file (platform ref-id). Never inline bytes.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: from_csv | from_xlsx | from_xls | from_ods | from_json | from_html | from_pdf | from_rtf | from_text | from_ics. Required. Example: 'from_csv'.

configurationParameters.label: Header Row
configurationParameters.description: First row is header for tabular formats. Default true.

configurationParameters.label: Sheet
configurationParameters.description: Sheet name or 0-based index for from_xlsx / from_xls / from_ods. Example: 'Sheet1'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
